registrationOwner.basis: Canonical public ADS repository origin is owned by this account. Public App visibility is selected so the same App can later be installed on additional user-controlled organizations/accounts without changing registration ownership.

appIdentity.description: GitHub capability layer for the Autonomous Data Science System through Codexless Runtime Bridge.

installationSettings.rationale: The 89-action target includes installation/account discovery and is intended to work across personal and organization installations. A private App could only be installed on its owner account. Public visibility does not itself grant repository authority; each installation remains separately approved and repository-scoped.
installationSettings.initialScopeRationale: Use the canonical public ADS repository for the first authorization/install/GraphQL sufficiency qualification to minimize blast radius. General parity scope is expanded only after G0 passes and with explicit installation approval.
installationSettings.productionScopePolicy: installation-derived; each account installation may be All repositories or Only select repositories as explicitly approved by the owner/admin. Runtime Bridge must never widen beyond GitHub installation scope.

prefillLimitations: GitHub registration URL parameters do not expose the Enable Device Flow toggle in the documented parameter table; verify/select it manually in the UI.
The documented URL-parameter surface does not expose the Expire user authorization tokens toggle; leave expiration enabled manually.
GitHub App name uniqueness is enforced by GitHub at creation time and cannot be proven by repository state.
Repository selection occurs at installation time, not registration time.
manualCreationChecklist: Open the frozen personal-account prefill URL.
Confirm GitHub App name is Codexless Runtime Bridge; if GitHub reports a uniqueness conflict, stop and report it rather than silently renaming.
Confirm homepage and description exactly match this artifact.
Leave Request user authorization (OAuth) during installation unchecked.
Leave Expire user authorization tokens enabled.
Leave Setup URL blank and Redirect on update disabled.
Disable Webhook Active; no webhook URL, secret or events.
Confirm exactly the seven repository permissions from the frozen manifest and no other permission families.
Do not generate a private key.
Record App ID and Client ID as non-secret identifiers; do not copy Client secret into chat/repository.
Install the App on the personal owner account with Only select repositories and select only shakaarlatief/autonomous-data-science-system for the first qualification.
